description: Source code for the ue_manager class, managing UE contexts, including creation, removal, and task scheduling within a telecommunications system.

classes.name: ue_manager
classes.description: Class responsible for managing UE contexts, including their creation, deletion, and task scheduling.

methods.name: stop
methods.description: Stops all UEs and the GTP-U demux.

methods.name: find_ue
methods.description: Finds a UE context by its index.

methods.name: add_ue
methods.description: Creates and adds a new UE context based on provided configuration.

methods.name: remove_ue
methods.description: Removes a specific UE context asynchronously.

methods.name: get_next_ue_index
methods.description: Finds the next available UE index.

methods.name: schedule_ue_async_task
methods.description: Schedules an asynchronous task for a specific UE.

methods.name: schedule_and_wait_ue_removal
methods.description: Schedules and waits for the removal of a UE.
